title: M0 — Repository foundation
description: Issue-driven development is operational: repository documentation, forms, labels, milestones, implementation backlog, PR metadata gate, and main branch protection. No runtime image delivery in this milestone.

title: v0.1.0 — AL2023 runtime prototype
description: Accept the shared runtime and Java/Python/Node.js contracts and licensing approach; lock official AL2023 inputs; assemble amd64 static/base foundations; pass final-container workload tests. Exit: auditable local prototype and accepted contracts for all three committed languages.

title: v0.2.0 — Multi-architecture CI
description: Build and validate linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, automate unprivileged PR builds, and document reproducibility and size measurements. Exit: both architectures pass the same runtime contract and stable file-manifest checks.

title: v1.0.0 — Verifiable stable release
description: Release static, base, java, python, and nodejs on both architectures with SBOM/provenance/licenses, vulnerability gates, signed immutable GHCR artifacts, consumer examples, and update/rollback policy. Exit: every committed language and foundation variant meets the published support contract.

title: v1.1.0 — Runtime extensions
description: After v1.0, evaluate isolated debugging and operational improvements for the supported runtime images. A standalone C++/cc image is excluded; Java, Python, and Node.js are already required in v1.0.

title: v0.3.0 — Java, Python, and Node.js runtimes
description: Qualify Corretto Java and official upstream Python and Node.js versions with locked AL2023 system libraries on native linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. The exit criteria include native workload tests, size budgets and stable-release evidence.
